verdict.rationale: Snowflake clearly supports operating on many items at once. COPY and Snowpipe load files in micro-batches, and COPY skips files it has already loaded (hands-on community report). Time Travel can restore every object inside a container, cloning a database or schema carries over grants on all its child objects, and Snowpark processes data at scale. Programmatic surfaces (the SQL API, REST APIs and the CLI) let these operations be scripted. Missing for 10: explicit docs on bulk or batch API endpoints, evidence of agent-driven bulk operations through the MCP server, and independent corroboration beyond the single COPY report.
